content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I’m able to help your business obtain a commercial loan, real estate loan, lines of credit, Small Business Administration (SBA) loan, and more. I’m currently working with Northeast Horticultural Services, a woman-owned business who has grown tremendously over the last decade, as well as many other businesses in New Haven and Hartford Counties.

A Little About Me

I’ve held numerous management positions with local banks throughout my career. I’m an active member of the community, sitting on several steering committees and boards for community parades, festivals, chambers of commerce, and more.

I am currently the Vice-Chairman of the Central Global Coast YMCA and Chairman of their Property Development Committee.   

Additionally, I am a member of the Board of Directors of MARC of Middletown and also serve on their Finance Committee.

I graduated from Saint Michael’s College with a BA in Business Administration, and I attended graduate school at University of New Haven.
